title: Email/import: keywords deserialized as Vec<Keyword> instead of HashMap<Keyword,bool>
description: email.rs:898 deserializes keywords as Vec<jmap_mail_types::Keyword>. Keyword is a string newtype. RFC 8621 §5.7 keywords wire format is String[Boolean] — a JSON object like {'$seen': true}. serde_json::from_value::<Vec<Keyword>>(object) fails, so any client sending valid JMAP keywords gets invalidProperties. Email/set create correctly uses HashMap<Keyword,bool>.
